title: STORM-BORN: A Challenging Mathematical Derivations Dataset Curated via a Human-in-the-Loop Multi-Agent Framework
authors_zh: Wenhao Liu、Zhenyi Lu、Xinyu Hu、Jierui Zhang、Dailin Li、Jiacheng Cen、Huilin Cao、Haiteng Wang、Yuhan Li、Kun Xie、Dandan Li、Pei Zhang、Chengbo Zhang、Yuxiang Ren、Xiaohong Huang、Yan Ma
paper_type_zh: 数学推导数据集、专家评测基准与人机协同构建配方
best_for_zh: 研究文档溯源推理数据、多智能体构造、专家判断、SFT 与科学数学评测审计的读者
one_line: A 100-row expert-selected derivation dataset built from a 2,000-pair multi-agent pool, released with source IDs, long answers, a 73/27 split, and four-option variants but without full lineage or the candidate pool.
STORM-BORN 从 2,000 条多智能体生成问答中由专家筛选出 100 条数学推导记录，并发布 73/27 切分与四选一变体；但完整谱系、候选池、人工协议与许可仍缺失。
why: STORM-BORN makes full scientific documents and expert judgment central to reasoning-data construction, while the live source mismatch, shared-source split, missing review history, partial code, and unresolved licensing show the audit cost of document-derived supervision.
inclusion_reason: STORM-BORN is a relevant open construction recipe because it converts mathematical derivations in full research documents into source-grounded natural-language supervision through modular extraction/retrieval/refinement stages and expert selection, while its artifact exposes concrete provenance, judgment, split, and rights risks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The authoritative publication is the 21-page Findings of ACL 2025 paper, pages 23938–23958, DOI 10.18653/v1/2025.findings-acl.1227; its appendix contains the principal agent prompts, resource notes, comparison examples, and derivation-evaluation rubric. This Card also audits the official repository at commit 1d3f0743717ccec23472692eb4e13d56f833bb2d, checked on 21 July 2026. Author names follow the PDF, which gives Jierui Zhang and Kun Xie; the ACL HTML renders those two differently.

STORM-BORN targets long natural-language mathematical derivations and proofs drawn from technical documents. The intended gap lies between short numerical word problems, whose terminal answer is easy to check but whose reasoning may be shallow, and formal theorem-proving corpora, whose proofs are machine-checkable but expressed in a proof language. The proposed object instead preserves formulas, approximations, dependencies, heuristic cues, and multi-step prose, so correctness requires source reading and mathematical judgment rather than answer-string comparison.

The final public object is much smaller and more concrete than the 2,000-pair construction pool described in the paper. data/storm-born.jsonl contains exactly 100 unique rows from 28 distinct source identifiers. Each row has paper, question, and whole_label: a coarse source name or arXiv ID, a self-contained derivation/proof question, and a long natural-language/LaTeX derivation. No row contains the original formula record, page/equation evidence, agent outputs, human decision, revision history, or quality score.

The repository also releases a random 73-row train split and 27-row test split that exactly partition the 100 questions with no question overlap. Four-option files expose paper, question, A–D, and ground-truth: one file covers all 100 questions and two byte-identical files cover the 27-question test subset. The advertised blank-format artifact currently contains only []. The train and test files are not source-document-disjoint: 17 of the test set's 18 source identifiers also appear in train.

This is a direct data_construction_open_release_recipes case because the paper specifies a document filter, six specialized agents, source-answer retrieval, context enrichment, expert selection, derived evaluation formats, and downstream SFT studies. Its canonical L3_summary_ready/partial state must remain. The 2,000 generated pool, top-500/fullset ablation data, rejected items, paper-selection manifest, exact human protocol, per-row evidence, and valid release licensing are absent, so the current artifact supports bounded reuse rather than a fully auditable reproduction.

权威出版记录是 Findings of ACL 2025 的 21 页论文，页码 23938–23958，DOI 为 10.18653/v1/2025.findings-acl.1227；其 appendix 提供主要 agent prompt、资源说明、对比样例与 derivation-evaluation rubric。本卡还审计了 2026 年 7 月 21 日的官方 repository commit 1d3f0743717ccec23472692eb4e13d56f833bb2d。作者名遵循 PDF，其中使用 Jierui Zhang 与 Kun Xie；ACL HTML 对这两人的显示不同。

STORM-BORN 面向从技术文档中抽取的长自然语言数学推导与证明。它试图填补两类数据之间的空白：短数值文字题的 terminal answer 易检查，但 reasoning 可能较浅；形式定理证明 corpus 可机器验证，但使用 proof language。这里的数据对象改为保留 formula、approximation、dependency、heuristic cue 与多步 prose，因此其正确性需要阅读来源与数学判断，不能只比较答案字符串。

最终公开对象比论文描述的 2,000 对 construction pool 更小、更具体。data/storm-born.jsonl 精确包含 100 个 unique row，来自 28 个不同 source identifier。每行有 paper、question 与 whole_label：粗粒度来源名或 arXiv ID、自包含 derivation/proof question，以及长自然语言／LaTeX 推导。行内不含原始 formula record、page/equation evidence、agent output、human decision、revision history 或 quality score。

Repository 还发布随机的 73-row train split 与 27-row test split，二者无 question overlap 且精确组成全部 100 道题。四选一文件提供 paper、question、A–D 与 ground-truth：一个文件覆盖 100 题，另两个内容逐字节相同的文件覆盖 27 题 test subset。所宣传的 blank-format artifact 当前只有 []。Train/test 并非 source-document-disjoint：test 的 18 个 source identifier 中有 17 个也出现在 train。

它直接属于 data_construction_open_release_recipes，因为论文明确给出 document filter、六个 specialized agent、source-answer retrieval、context enrichment、expert selection、derived evaluation format 与下游 SFT study。其规范 L3_summary_ready／partial 状态必须保留。2,000 条生成池、top-500/fullset ablation data、rejected item、paper-selection manifest、精确 human protocol、逐行 evidence 与有效 release license 均缺失，因此当前 artifact 只能支持有边界的复用，而非完整可审计复现。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
STORM decomposes document-to-derivation-data construction into six roles instead of asking one model to read a full paper, choose an advanced formula, invent a self-contained question, and reproduce its proof in one prompt. The Math Expression Extractor identifies formulas, theorems, lemmas, and corollaries and converts them to LaTeX. Query Draft turns an expression and its dependencies into a derivation/proof question. Answer Retriever is instructed to extract the answer from the source rather than solve it. Context Collector finds omitted definitions and dependencies. Question Refiner folds that evidence into a self-contained question. Answer Filter distinguishes derivations/proofs from definitions or quotations.

The intended grounding contract is document extraction, not free-form teacher reasoning. The appendix instructs Answer Retriever to search the first occurrence, appendix, and relevant sections; skip unsupported questions; include the complete derivation; preserve source meaning; expand referenced formulas; and append evidence location. Yet the final three-field rows discard that evidence field and all intermediate formula/context records. A consumer can inspect the coarse paper identifier but cannot directly verify page-level grounding without redoing retrieval.

Human feedback is the terminal verifier. Experts familiar with the source papers review generated question-answer pairs, retain acceptable examples, reject low-value examples, and manually improve borderline ones. The stated criteria are reasoning type, problem clarity, derivation correctness, and reasoning density. The paper calls these “five” principles but enumerates Q1–Q4 only. No annotator count, topic assignment, numeric threshold, independent double review, inter-annotator agreement, adjudication, or item-level before/after revision is released.

Benchmark feedback has two further forms that must remain separate from curation. For open-ended STORM-BORN answers, each evaluated model produces three responses per question and human experts score a fully correct derivation as 1, with partial credit proportional to completed key steps. For a separate NuminaMath-1.5 formula-derivation test, DeepSeek-R1 compares a candidate with a ground-truth proof and scores correctness, completeness, and similarity from 0 to 2. Multiple-choice variants permit exact option-letter scoring, but the distractors are not proven equivalent to evaluating a generated derivation.

The contribution is thus a human-judged, source-retrieval recipe rather than a formal verifier or reward model. Its released question/whole_label pairs support SFT, and the 27-row test plus options support evaluation. No process labels, preferences, scalar reward, executable environment, or formal proof object justify RL or process-supervision claims.

STORM 把 document-to-derivation-data construction 分解为六个角色，而不是在一个 prompt 中要求单一模型读完整论文、选择高级公式、发明自包含问题并复现证明。Math Expression Extractor 识别 formula、theorem、lemma 与 corollary 并转为 LaTeX；Query Draft 把表达式及其 dependency 转成 derivation/proof question；Answer Retriever 被要求从来源抽取答案而不是自行求解；Context Collector 查找缺失 definition 与 dependency；Question Refiner 把 evidence 融入自包含问题；Answer Filter 区分 derivation/proof 与 definition/quotation。

预期 grounding contract 是 document extraction，而不是自由生成的 teacher reasoning。Appendix 要求 Answer Retriever 搜索公式首次出现位置、appendix 与相关 section，跳过无来源支持的问题，纳入完整推导，保留原文含义，展开被引用公式，并附 evidence location。然而，最终三字段 row 丢弃了 evidence field 和全部中间 formula/context record。使用者只能检查粗粒度 paper identifier，若要验证 page-level grounding，必须重新执行检索。

Human feedback 是 terminal verifier。熟悉来源论文的专家审查生成的 question-answer pair，保留合格样例、拒绝低价值样例，并手工改进边界样例。明示 criteria 是 reasoning type、problem clarity、derivation correctness 与 reasoning density。论文把它们称为“五项”原则，却只列出 Q1–Q4。没有发布 annotator count、topic assignment、numeric threshold、independent double review、inter-annotator agreement、adjudication，或逐项 revision 前后版本。

Benchmark feedback 另有两种形式，不能与 curation 混为一谈。对开放式 STORM-BORN answer，每个被测模型每题生成 3 个 response，由 human expert 把完全正确 derivation 记为 1 分，并按完成的关键步骤比例给 partial credit。对独立 NuminaMath-1.5 formula-derivation test，DeepSeek-R1 比较 candidate 与 ground-truth proof，对 correctness、completeness、similarity 各给 0–2 分。Multiple-choice variant 可以做 option-letter exact scoring，但 distractor 并不等价于评估生成式推导。

因此，其贡献是 human-judged、source-retrieval recipe，而不是 formal verifier 或 reward model。发布的 question/whole_label pair 支持 SFT，27-row test 与 options 支持 evaluation。没有 process label、preference、scalar reward、executable environment 或 formal proof object 可以支持 RL 或 process-supervision 声称。

title: Method
方法
html:
The evidence-backed pipeline is:

  1. Filter documents. The paper says candidates are arXiv-hosted peer-reviewed papers published May 2023–October 2024, scored above weak accept on OpenReview, and rich in derivation language. More than five occurrences of markers such as “assume,” “derive,” and “proof” make a document likely to pass. Candidate counts, precise venues, source URLs/versions, thresholds beyond this heuristic, and rejected manifests are not reported.
  2. Extract expressions. A lightweight multimodal model reads the document, identifies important numbered/displayed formulas, theorems, lemmas, and corollaries, removes exact LaTeX duplicates, and emits typed JSONL expressions. The authors moved away from OCR after incomplete formula-box extraction. Current code uses Gemini file/PDF input at temperature 0.0.
  3. Draft questions. Query Draft reads the entire paper and each expression, locates prerequisite formulas/settings/symbol definitions, and writes at least one derivation or proof question that includes full dependencies rather than equation numbers alone. The reported production model is GPT-o1-Pro; Appendix B says it was used through the web UI, with papers converted to screenshots because no PDF API was available.
  4. Retrieve source answers. Answer Retriever reads the whole document, finds the first occurrence and relevant appendix/sections, skips expressions without an answer, and extracts the complete derivation rather than inventing one. It is instructed to preserve meaning, include referenced formulas, and record an evidence location. GPT-o1-Pro is again the reported production model.
  5. Collect context and refine. Context Collector recovers definitions, premises, and cited expressions needed to interpret the answer. Question Refiner integrates that evidence so a solver should not need the source document. Current public scripts use gemini-2.0-flash-exp, with temperature 0.05 for context collection and 0.0 for refinement; these code defaults are not a faithful specification of the manual GPT-o1-Pro run.
  6. Filter answer type. Answer Filter asks deepseek-chat in the public code to classify a question/whole_label pair as derivation/proof versus definition/reference and keeps the former. The paper does not report classifier validation, false-accept/reject rates, or per-stage survivor counts.
  7. Apply expert selection. Human mathematicians familiar with the source documents inspect 2,000 generated pairs, accept, reject, or revise them using reasoning type, clarity, correctness, and density, and form a top-100 set. The paper reports about 30 pairs and 15 expert minutes per paper, but the number of experts/documents and assignment/adjudication protocol are unknown.
  8. Package variants. Publish 100 paper/question/whole_label rows, randomly split them 73/27, and derive four-option files. The code tree does not contain the split or distractor-generation pipeline, and the empty blank file does not instantiate the advertised fill-blank format.

Resource reporting is partial. The authors spent about USD 200 on one month of GPT-o1-Pro, about three weeks engineering prompts, and around 20 minutes of multi-agent processing per paper; failures sometimes required two or three attempts. Total candidate-paper count, token/call budget, expert hours, and compute are unknown.

The repository exposes individual agent scripts, a misspelled pipline.py orchestrator, cleaning/evaluation utilities, and final data. It does not preserve an environment lockfile, source PDFs, run configuration, raw/intermediate outputs, 2,000-item pool, expert history, or model revisions. It also includes a hard-coded Google credential-like string in generate_v1.py; this Card does not reproduce it. The train/ directory contains images rather than training code, and the README's “typical” Axolotl command is illustrative, not an experimental manifest.

证据支持的 pipeline 如下：

  1. 筛选文档。 论文称 candidate 是托管于 arXiv、发表于 2023 年 5 月至 2024 年 10 月、经过 peer review 且 OpenReview 分数高于 weak accept 的论文，并具有密集 derivation language。“assume”“derive”“proof”等 marker 出现超过 5 次，会被认为更可能合格。Candidate 数量、精确 venue、source URL/version、该 heuristic 之外的 threshold 与 rejected manifest 均未报告。
  2. 抽取表达式。 轻量 multimodal model 阅读文档，识别重要 numbered/displayed formula、theorem、lemma 与 corollary，去除 exact LaTeX duplicate，并输出 typed JSONL expression。由于 OCR 会产生不完整 formula-box extraction，作者改用 MLLM。当前代码使用 Gemini file/PDF input，temperature 为 0.0。
  3. 起草问题。 Query Draft 阅读整篇论文与每个 expression，定位 prerequisite formula、setting 与 symbol definition，并为每个 expression 至少生成一道 derivation/proof question；问题必须展开完整 dependency，不能只写 equation number。报告的 production model 是 GPT-o1-Pro；Appendix B 说明其通过 web UI 使用，因为没有 PDF API，论文被转换为 screenshot 后逐步上传。
  4. 检索来源答案。 Answer Retriever 阅读完整文档，查找首次出现位置以及相关 appendix/section，跳过没有答案的 expression，并抽取完整 derivation 而非自行发明。Prompt 要求保留原意、纳入被引用公式并记录 evidence location。报告的 production model 同样是 GPT-o1-Pro。
  5. 补充上下文并精炼。 Context Collector 恢复理解答案所需的 definition、premise 与 cited expression；Question Refiner 把这些 evidence 融入问题，使求解者不需要源文档。当前公开脚本使用 gemini-2.0-flash-exp，context collection temperature 为 0.05，refinement 为 0.0；这些代码默认值不是人工 GPT-o1-Pro 运行的忠实规格。
  6. 过滤答案类型。 公开代码中的 Answer Filter 让 deepseek-chat 把 question/whole_label pair 分类为 derivation/proof 或 definition/reference，并保留前者。论文没有报告 classifier validation、false-accept/reject rate 或逐阶段 survivor count。
  7. 进行专家筛选。 熟悉来源文档的 human mathematician 检查 2,000 条生成 pair，依据 reasoning type、clarity、correctness 与 density 接受、拒绝或修订，形成 top-100。论文报告每篇约 30 条 pair、专家处理约 15 分钟，但 expert/document 数量与 assignment/adjudication protocol 为 unknown。
  8. 打包变体。 发布 100 条 paper/question/whole_label row，随机切分为 73/27，再派生四选一文件。代码树不含 split 或 distractor-generation pipeline；空 blank file 也没有真正实现所宣传的 fill-blank format。

资源报告不完整。作者称 GPT-o1-Pro 一个月订阅约 USD 200，prompt engineering 约 3 周，每篇论文的 multi-agent processing 约 20 分钟；失败有时需要 2–3 次尝试。总 candidate-paper 数、token/call budget、expert hour 与 compute 均为 unknown。

Repository 暴露单个 agent script、拼写为 pipline.py 的 orchestrator、cleaning/evaluation utility 与最终数据，却没有 environment lockfile、source PDF、run configuration、raw/intermediate output、2,000-item pool、expert history 或 model revision。generate_v1.py 还包含硬编码 Google credential-like string；本卡不复现该内容。train/ 目录只有图片而非 training code，README 中的“typical” Axolotl command 是示例，不是实验 manifest。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest difficulty evidence is expert-scored model evaluation on the 100 selected problems. Each model produces three responses per question; experts award 1 for a fully correct derivation and proportional partial credit for completed key steps. Figure 3 reports solved-problem rates of 0.0% for GPT-4o (20240806), 2.7% for GPT-o1-Mini, 3.6% for GPT-o1-Preview, 3.0% for GPT-o1, 4.6% for GPT-o1-Pro, and 3.3% for DeepSeek-R1. These results show that this particular expert-selected set was difficult for the tested snapshots. Selection explicitly targeted difficult items, so they are not an unbiased estimate of mathematical ability.

Table 1 provides mixed downstream SFT evidence, not uniformly positive results. LLaMA3-8B changes from 15.39 to 42.91 on GSM8K zero-shot and from 0.12 to 7.96 on MATH zero-shot, but falls from 50.27 to 45.49 on GSM8K 8-shot and from 17.08 to 13.82 on MATH 4-shot. Qwen2.5-7B changes from 80.67/83.32/67.82/54.42 to 81.96/83.70/67.96/63.54 across those four settings. The headline 7.84 and 9.12 figures are absolute MATH gains in selected settings, not aggregate accuracy improvements.

Table 2 reports Qwen2.5-7B increasing from 0.00% to 3.33% on AIME 2024 and from 3.33% to 6.67% on AIME 2025; Qwen2.5-32B moves from 20.00% to 23.33% and remains 15.00% on the two sets. These evaluation sets are tiny, uncertainty is unreported, and paper/source overlap is not audited.

For formula derivation, the paper fine-tunes Qwen2.5-7B and evaluates on a test set extracted from NuminaMath-1.5. DeepSeek-R1 compares model answers to ground-truth proofs and scores correctness, completeness, and similarity on 0–2 scales. The mean rises from 0.91 to 1.07 (reported as 17.58% relative); component means change from 1.10/1.14/0.50 to 1.23/1.32/0.66. Because this is a single LLM judge and the paper itself observes that LLMs can overrate flawed derivations, it is weaker than the expert benchmark evidence.

The quality ablation trains LLaMA2-7B on top-100, top-500, 2K, and a separately labeled fullset. Top-100 gives the best listed GSM8K zero-shot/8-shot results, 8.80/16.98, versus top-500 at 8.11/15.09 and 2K at 6.70/14.87. The fullset reaches 5.16/14.10, below the 7.96/14.33 base on those GSM8K settings. This supports the paper's selection argument for the tested model but does not isolate expert revision from difficulty selection or source mixture, and none of the larger ablation datasets is in the current repository.

Artifact inspection confirms 100 unique questions, 28 source identifiers, an exact 73/27 question partition, and 100-row and 27-row choice variants. It also reveals source/filter and split facts absent from the paper: two 2025 arXiv IDs, three books, and 17 of 18 test sources shared with train. Benchmark performance must not be treated as evidence of decontamination, license compatibility, or record-level correctness.

最强的 difficulty evidence 是对 100 道入选题目的专家评分模型评测。每个模型每题生成 3 个 response；专家对完全正确 derivation 记 1 分，并按完成的关键步骤给比例 partial credit。Figure 3 报告 solved-problem rate：GPT-4o (20240806) 为 0.0%，GPT-o1-Mini 2.7%，GPT-o1-Preview 3.6%，GPT-o1 3.0%，GPT-o1-Pro 4.6%，DeepSeek-R1 3.3%。这些结果说明该专家筛选集合对被测 snapshot 很难。由于 selection 明确以困难样例为目标，它们不是对一般数学能力的无偏估计。

Table 1 提供的是有正有负的 downstream SFT evidence，并非一致提升。LLaMA3-8B 在 GSM8K zero-shot 上从 15.39 变为 42.91，在 MATH zero-shot 上从 0.12 变为 7.96；但 GSM8K 8-shot 从 50.27 降到 45.49，MATH 4-shot 从 17.08 降到 13.82。Qwen2.5-7B 在四个 setting 上从 80.67/83.32/67.82/54.42 变为 81.96/83.70/67.96/63.54。标题中的 7.84 与 9.12 是特定 MATH setting 的 absolute gain，而非 aggregate accuracy improvement。

Table 2 报告 Qwen2.5-7B 在 AIME 2024 上从 0.00% 增至 3.33%，AIME 2025 从 3.33% 增至 6.67%；Qwen2.5-32B 在两套数据上从 20.00% 增至 23.33%，以及保持 15.00% 不变。这些 evaluation set 很小，论文未报告 uncertainty，也没有审计 paper/source overlap。

Formula derivation 实验对 Qwen2.5-7B 做 fine-tuning，并在从 NuminaMath-1.5 抽取的 test set 上评估。DeepSeek-R1 把模型回答与 ground-truth proof 比较，对 correctness、completeness、similarity 各给 0–2 分。平均值从 0.91 增至 1.07（论文称相对提升 17.58%）；三个分项均值从 1.10/1.14/0.50 变为 1.23/1.32/0.66。由于这是单一 LLM judge，而且论文自身观察到 LLM 会高估错误推导，该证据弱于专家 benchmark evidence。

Quality ablation 用 top-100、top-500、2K 与另一个标作 fullset 的集合训练 LLaMA2-7B。Top-100 在所列 GSM8K zero-shot/8-shot 上最高，为 8.80/16.98；top-500 为 8.11/15.09，2K 为 6.70/14.87。Fullset 为 5.16/14.10，低于 base 的 7.96/14.33。这支持该模型与 setup 下的 selection 论点，但无法区分 expert revision、difficulty selection 与 source mixture 的影响；当前 repository 也没有发布任何较大 ablation dataset。

Artifact 检查确认 100 道 unique question、28 个 source identifier、精确 73/27 question partition，以及 100-row 和 27-row choice variant；同时发现论文未披露的 source/filter 与 split 事实：两个 2025 arXiv ID、三本书，以及 test 的 18 个来源中有 17 个也在 train。Benchmark performance 不能作为 decontamination、license compatibility 或逐记录正确性的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Numerical-reasoning datasets already provide natural-language steps, formal theorem-proving datasets already offer rigorous verification, scientific-paper corpora already contain equations, and multi-agent pipelines already divide complex generation tasks. STORM-BORN does not originate those components separately.

Its first concrete shift is the source object: complete derivations from contemporary technical documents rather than short competition problems or proof-assistant statements. Questions are built around formula dependencies, approximation choices, lemmas, and source context. The goal is to preserve the kind of informal but technically dense reasoning that appears in papers and appendices, including heuristic transitions that are usually omitted from answer-only datasets.

The second shift is the six-stage modularization of grounding. Formula recognition, question drafting, source answer retrieval, context collection, self-contained rewriting, and answer-type filtering are distinct operations. That separation makes each failure class conceptually inspectable—formula omission, missing prerequisite, unsupported answer, lost context, underspecified question, or non-derivational content—even though the release does not retain the intermediate records needed to audit them row by row.

The third shift is human expert selection at a deliberately small scale. The authors reduce 2,000 generated pairs to 100 based on complexity, clarity, correctness, and reasoning density, and compare top-100 with larger subsets. The intended lesson is not simply “more synthetic data”; it is that source retrieval plus expensive domain judgment can produce a small training and evaluation object. The ablation is suggestive, but it does not prove that 100 is generally optimal or identify which expert action caused each gain.

The open release adds derived train/test and multiple-choice views, enabling SFT and lower-cost option evaluation. Yet the verified novelty is the final 100-row dataset and documented recipe—not a fully transparent human-feedback corpus. Missing candidate pools, evidence spans, expert edits, and option lineage prevent direct study of the selection process that the paper presents as central.

A stronger successor would publish document versions and rights, formula/evidence spans, every agent input/output, accept/reject/revise decisions, annotator assignments and agreement, larger ablation subsets, source-disjoint splits, and calibrated independent evaluation. Those additions would convert the human-in-the-loop claim from a paper-level narrative into a reusable data contract.

Numerical-reasoning dataset 已提供自然语言步骤，formal theorem-proving dataset 已提供严格验证，scientific-paper corpus 已包含 equation，multi-agent pipeline 也早已分解复杂生成任务。STORM-BORN 并未单独首创这些组件。

第一项具体变化是 source object：以当代技术文档中的完整推导为对象，而不是短竞赛题或 proof-assistant statement。问题围绕 formula dependency、approximation choice、lemma 与 source context 构造，目标是保留论文和 appendix 中常见的非形式化但技术密集 reasoning，包括 answer-only dataset 经常遗漏的 heuristic transition。

第二项变化是把 grounding 模块化为六个阶段。Formula recognition、question drafting、source answer retrieval、context collection、self-contained rewriting 与 answer-type filtering 各自独立。这样可以在概念上区分每类 failure——formula omission、missing prerequisite、unsupported answer、lost context、underspecified question 或 non-derivational content——尽管 release 没有保留逐行审计所需的中间记录。

第三项变化是刻意采用小规模 human expert selection。作者依据 complexity、clarity、correctness 与 reasoning density，把 2,000 个生成 pair 缩减为 100 个，并将 top-100 与更大子集比较。其预期启示不是简单增加 synthetic data，而是 source retrieval 加昂贵 domain judgment 可以形成小型 training/evaluation object。Ablation 具有提示性，但不能证明 100 在一般情况下最优，也不能识别每项 gain 来自哪种 expert action。

开放 release 还增加 train/test 与 multiple-choice view，支持 SFT 和成本较低的选项评测。但已核验的新意是最终 100-row dataset 与文档化 recipe，而不是完全透明的 human-feedback corpus。Candidate pool、evidence span、expert edit 与 option lineage 缺失，使研究者无法直接分析论文所强调的 selection process。

更强的后续工作应发布 document version 与 rights、formula/evidence span、每个 agent input/output、accept/reject/revise decision、annotator assignment/agreement、更大 ablation subset、source-disjoint split 与经校准的独立评测。这样才能把 human-in-the-loop 从论文级叙事转化为可复用 data contract。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The released source list does not follow the paper's literal selection description. It includes three named books, an older named paper, and arXiv IDs from January and February 2025 despite the stated May 2023–October 2024 window. No candidate manifest, OpenReview links/scores, venue labels, or filter logs explain these exceptions.
  • Row-level grounding is too coarse for direct audit. paper is only a title or arXiv ID; the final file drops formula type/content, page/equation span, retrieved evidence, context, agent/model revision, retries, and human edits. None of the 100 answers retains the appendix prompt's requested evidence: suffix.
  • The expert protocol is underspecified. The paper does not give the number of mathematicians, their topical qualifications, assignments, independence, double-review rate, agreement, adjudication, rejection counts, or revision history. It says there are five selection principles but lists only four.
  • Difficulty evaluation is selection-conditioned. Experts deliberately choose the hardest 100, then report low model solve rates on those same items. This supports benchmark challenge but does not estimate performance on the generated pool or establish broad coverage.
  • Automatic derivation evaluation uses DeepSeek-R1 even though the authors explicitly report that LLMs can give perfect scores to flawed derivations. No human correlation, judge version, repeatability, confidence interval, or adversarial calibration is reported.
  • The 73/27 random split is not source-disjoint: 17 of 18 test sources also occur in train. Models can encounter related notation, definitions, theorem families, or document phrasing during SFT. The random seed and grouping policy are unknown.
  • The 100-row choice file provides three distractors per question, but no distractor-generation script, source, validator, or human acceptance record is released. Option artifacts may make letter selection easier than producing a valid derivation.
  • The 2,000-pair pool, top-500 set, separately labeled fullset, rejected candidates, and stage outputs used by the quality argument are absent. Counts before the 2,000 stage are unknown, so selection rates and failure distributions cannot be calculated.
  • The code is not an exact reproduction package. Reported GPT-o1-Pro stages were manual web interactions with screenshot uploads, while public scripts default to Gemini and DeepSeek; dependencies are unpinned, the orchestrator filename is misspelled, and no run config/source PDFs are included.
  • A generation script contains a hard-coded Google API-key-like credential. It should be considered exposed/revoked and replaced with environment-based secret loading; the value is intentionally omitted here.
  • The README claims MIT, but the repository contains no LICENSE file and GitHub detects no license. Final answers extract or lightly edit third-party paper/book text, while rows lack source-license and attribution metadata. Public accessibility does not by itself grant redistribution or commercial-training rights.
  • The paper claims freshness helps avoid contamination, but reports no exact, near-duplicate, semantic, or memorization audit. Later/older sources in the live release and document overlap across train/test make decontamination remain unknown.

• 发布的 source list 不符合论文对 selection 的字面描述。它包含三本具名书籍、一篇较早的具名论文，以及 2025 年 1 月和 2 月的 arXiv ID，超出所称 2023 年 5 月至 2024 年 10 月窗口。没有 candidate manifest、OpenReview link/score、venue label 或 filter log 解释这些例外。
  • Row-level grounding 过于粗糙，无法直接审计。paper 只是标题或 arXiv ID；最终文件丢弃 formula type/content、page/equation span、retrieved evidence、context、agent/model revision、retry 与 human edit。100 条答案中没有一条保留 appendix prompt 要求的 evidence: 后缀。
  • Expert protocol 未充分披露。论文没有给出 mathematician 数量、topic qualification、assignment、independence、double-review rate、agreement、adjudication、rejection count 或 revision history；同时称有五项 selection principle，却只列出四项。
  • Difficulty evaluation 受 selection 条件影响。专家先刻意选出最难的 100 题，再报告模型在同一集合上的低 solve rate。这可以支持 benchmark challenge，却不能估计生成池上的表现，也不能证明广泛覆盖。
  • Automatic derivation evaluation 使用 DeepSeek-R1，而作者明确观察到 LLM 可能给错误推导满分。没有报告 human correlation、judge version、repeatability、confidence interval 或 adversarial calibration。
  • 73/27 random split 不是 source-disjoint：test 的 18 个来源中有 17 个也在 train。模型在 SFT 时可能见到相关 notation、definition、theorem family 或 document phrasing。Random seed 与 grouping policy 均为 unknown。
  • 100-row choice file 每题有 3 个 distractor，但没有发布 distractor-generation script、source、validator 或 human acceptance record。Option artifact 可能使选字母比生成有效推导更容易。
  • Quality 论证使用的 2,000-pair pool、top-500 set、另标作 fullset 的集合、rejected candidate 与 stage output 均缺失。2,000 阶段之前的数量也未知，无法计算 selection rate 与 failure distribution。
  • Code 不是精确 reproduction package。论文中的 GPT-o1-Pro 阶段通过 web 手工交互并上传 screenshot，而公开脚本默认 Gemini 与 DeepSeek；dependency 未固定，orchestrator 文件名拼写错误，也没有 run config/source PDF。
  • 一个 generation script 含硬编码 Google API-key-like credential。它应被视为已经暴露／需撤销，并改用 environment-based secret loading；本卡刻意不复现该值。
  • README 声称 MIT，但 repository 没有 LICENSE file，GitHub 也未检测到 license。最终 answer 抽取或轻度编辑第三方 paper/book text，而 row 不含 source-license 与 attribution metadata。公开可访问本身不授予再分发或商业训练权利。
  • 论文称 freshness 有助于避免 contamination，但没有报告 exact、near-duplicate、semantic 或 memorization audit。Live release 中更晚／更早的来源以及 train/test 间 document overlap，使 decontamination 必须保持 unknown。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For data_construction_open_release_recipes, STORM-BORN offers a compact case study in converting full scientific documents into reasoning supervision. Builders can reuse the six-role decomposition—expression extraction, dependency-aware question drafting, source-answer retrieval, context recovery, self-contained rewriting, and answer-type filtering—while replacing opaque web interactions with versioned calls and preserving every intermediate record.

For SFT, the 100 question/whole_label pairs provide long, LaTeX-heavy targets that emphasize derivation and proof rather than short numerical answers. The 73-row train split is immediately loadable, but its size makes results seed-sensitive, and source overlap with test requires either a document-disjoint resplit or explicit disclosure. Training should retain paper and add page/equation evidence rather than stripping provenance.

For evaluation, the 27-row open-ended test can support expert-scored derivation studies, while the identical 27-row choice variants provide a cheaper exact-letter proxy. The full 100-row choice file can support controlled diagnostics but must not be mixed with the released train split without leakage. Researchers should audit whether distractors are logically wrong, stylistically detectable, or copied across examples before reporting option accuracy.

The dataset is especially useful for studying verifier limits. One can compare source-span checking, independent mathematicians, proof-oriented LLM judges, symbolic spot checks, and multiple-choice conversion; measure errors such as algebra slips, unproven assumptions, notation misuse, and logical leaps; and quantify how much source context is needed for a self-contained prompt. The paper's own warning that LLM judges overrate flawed derivations makes independent calibration essential.

Reuse class: conditionally usable for sft and evaluation after source/license review, evidence reconstruction, secret-safe code handling, and source-disjoint splitting. It is useful as an audit seed for document-grounded reasoning data. It is blocked as a complete reproduction of the 2,000-to-100 selection process, a preference/reward dataset, or a formally verified proof corpus. Benchmark gains and low solve rates do not remove those boundaries.

对 data_construction_open_release_recipes 而言，STORM-BORN 是把完整科学文档转换为 reasoning supervision 的紧凑案例。构建者可以复用六角色分解：expression extraction、dependency-aware question drafting、source-answer retrieval、context recovery、self-contained rewriting 与 answer-type filtering；同时应把不透明 web interaction 替换为版本化调用，并保留全部中间记录。

对 SFT，100 个 question/whole_label pair 提供长篇、LaTeX 密集的 target，强调 derivation/proof 而不是短 numerical answer。73-row train split 可直接加载，但体量很小，结果容易受 seed 影响；它与 test 存在 source overlap，因此需要按 document 重新切分或显式披露。训练时应保留 paper 并增加 page/equation evidence，而不是删除 provenance。

对 evaluation，27-row 开放式 test 可支持 expert-scored derivation study，两个内容相同的 27-row choice variant 则提供成本较低的 exact-letter proxy。完整 100-row choice file 可用于受控诊断，但若与发布的 train split 混用会产生 leakage。报告 option accuracy 前，应检查 distractor 是否逻辑错误、是否可由风格识别，或是否跨样例复制。

该数据尤其适合研究 verifier limit。可以比较 source-span checking、independent mathematician、proof-oriented LLM judge、symbolic spot check 与 multiple-choice conversion；测量 algebra slip、unproven assumption、notation misuse、logical leap 等错误；并量化 self-contained prompt 需要多少 source context。论文自己已警告 LLM judge 会高估错误推导，因此独立 calibration 必不可少。

复用等级：完成 source/license review、evidence reconstruction、安全 secret handling 与 source-disjoint split 后，可条件用于 sft 与 evaluation；也适合作为 document-grounded reasoning data 的审计种子。它不能支持完整复现 2,000→100 selection process，也不是 preference/reward dataset 或 formally verified proof corpus。Benchmark gain 与低 solve rate 不会消除这些边界。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read §§3.1–3.3 with Appendices A–B. The core object flow is document → expression → dependency-aware query → source-extracted answer → recovered context → self-contained question → derivation filter → expert accept/reject/revise decision.
  • Keep three evaluation contracts separate: expert selection of dataset rows, expert scoring of three model responses per STORM-BORN question, and DeepSeek-R1's 0–2 derivation rubric on a separate NuminaMath-1.5 test. The choice files add a fourth, exact-letter proxy.
  • Treat “five principles” cautiously: the paper enumerates only Q1 reasoning type, Q2 clarity, Q3 correctness, and Q4 density. Human counts, agreement, adjudication, thresholds, and row-level revisions are unknown.
  • Inspect the live artifact, not only the method narrative. It contains 100 rows/28 sources, a random 73/27 split, 17 shared sources across train/test, three book names, and two 2025 arXiv IDs outside the stated cutoff.
  • Read Table 1 in full: some zero-shot scores improve substantially, while LLaMA3-8B's GSM8K 8-shot and MATH 4-shot results decline. The headline gains are selected absolute improvements, not universal effects.
  • Pin commit 1d3f0743717ccec23472692eb4e13d56f833bb2d. Before reuse, rebuild page/equation evidence, create source-disjoint splits, validate distractors and judges, audit source rights, and remove/revoke the exposed credential-like string.

• 联读 §§3.1–3.3 与 Appendices A–B。核心 object flow 是 document → expression → dependency-aware query → source-extracted answer → recovered context → self-contained question → derivation filter → expert accept/reject/revise decision。
  • 区分三种 evaluation contract：expert selection 选择数据行；专家对每道 STORM-BORN 题的 3 个 model response 评分；DeepSeek-R1 在独立 NuminaMath-1.5 test 上按 0–2 derivation rubric 评分。Choice file 又增加第四种 exact-letter proxy。
  • 谨慎对待“五项原则”：论文实际只列 Q1 reasoning type、Q2 clarity、Q3 correctness、Q4 density。Human count、agreement、adjudication、threshold 与逐行 revision 均为 unknown。
  • 不要只读 method narrative，还要检查 live artifact。它有 100 行／28 个来源、随机 73/27 split、train/test 间 17 个 shared source、三个书名，以及两个超出所称截止日期的 2025 arXiv ID。
  • 完整阅读 Table 1：部分 zero-shot score 大幅提高，但 LLaMA3-8B 的 GSM8K 8-shot 与 MATH 4-shot 结果下降。Headline gain 是选定 setting 的 absolute improvement，不是普遍效果。
  • 固定 commit 1d3f0743717ccec23472692eb4e13d56f833bb2d。复用前重建 page/equation evidence，建立 source-disjoint split，验证 distractor 与 judge，审计 source rights，并删除／撤销已暴露的 credential-like string。

value.html: The paper describes selecting arXiv-hosted, peer-reviewed papers dated May 2023 through October 2024, with OpenReview scores above weak accept and more than five occurrences of derivation markers such as assume, derive, and proof. The live 100-row release instead names 28 sources and includes three book titles, an older named paper, and arXiv identifiers from January and February 2025; it does not publish the candidate-paper manifest, review scores, or filter decisions.

value_zh.html: 论文描述选取 2023 年 5 月至 2024 年 10 月期间托管于 arXiv、经同行评审的论文，其 OpenReview 分数高于 weak accept，且 assume、derive 与 proof 等推导标记出现超过五次。当前 100 行发布却点名 28 个来源，并包含三个书名、一篇更早的具名论文，以及 2025 年 1 月与 2 月的 arXiv 标识符；它未发布候选论文清单、评审分数或过滤决定。

Derived files provide a 73/27 random train/test split and four-option variants with fields A through D plus ground-truth. The shipped blank-format file is empty ([]).

value_zh.html: 规范发布 storm-born.jsonl 恰好包含 100 条 JSONL 记录，字符串字段为 paper、question 与 whole_label；whole_label 是长自然语言/LaTeX 推导或证明。派生文件提供 73/27 随机 train/test 划分，以及带字段 A 至 D 加 ground-truth 的四选项变体。随附的 blank-format 文件为空（[]）。

value.html: A six-agent STORM pipeline extracts mathematical expressions, drafts derivation/proof questions, retrieves answers from the source document, collects missing context, refines questions to be self-contained, and filters definition-like answers. GPT-o1-Pro is reported for the difficult query and answer stages; human mathematicians then retain, reject, or revise candidates. The released answer is therefore source-grounded and potentially human-edited, but row-level agent and editor attribution is absent.

value_zh.html: 六智能体 STORM 流水线提取数学表达式、起草推导/证明问题、从来源文档检索答案、收集缺失上下文、将问题精炼为自包含，并过滤类定义答案。困难查询与答案阶段据报告使用 GPT-o1-Pro；随后人类数学家保留、拒绝或修订候选。因此已发布答案是来源有依据的，并可能经人工编辑，但缺少行级智能体与编辑者归属。

value.html: The source paper or book is the retrieval environment. Agents inspect full documents; Appendix B states that GPT-o1-Pro lacked a PDF API, so papers were converted to page screenshots and gradually uploaded through the web interface. The final release preserves only a coarse source identifier, not page/equation spans, screenshots, extracted formula records, or supporting evidence fields.

value_zh.html: 来源论文或书籍是检索环境。智能体检视完整文档；附录 B 称 GPT-o1-Pro 缺少 PDF API，因此论文被转换为页面截图并经网页界面逐步上传。最终发布仅保留粗粒度来源标识符，而非页/方程跨度、截图、提取的公式记录或支撑证据字段。

value.html: Verification is expert judgment rather than an executable or formal reward. Mathematicians assess reasoning type, problem clarity, derivation correctness, and reasoning density, and may accept, reject, or revise an item. For benchmark responses, experts score full correctness as 1 and partial credit by the fraction of key steps; a separate DeepSeek-R1 prompt scores correctness, completeness, and similarity from 0 to 2 for a NuminaMath-1.5 derivation test. Neither score is released as a reusable per-row reward.

value_zh.html: 核验是专家判断而非可执行或形式奖励。数学家评估推理类型、问题清晰度、推导正确性与推理密度，并可接受、拒绝或修订条目。对于基准响应，专家将完全正确评为 1，部分分数按关键步骤比例；单独的 DeepSeek-R1 提示对 NuminaMath-1.5 推导测试按 0 到 2 评分正确性、完整性与相似性。两种分数均未作为可复用的逐行奖励发布。

value.html: A generated question-answer pair enters the top-100 set when expert review retains it, possibly after manual revision, as sufficiently complex, clear, correct, and reasoning-dense. The paper does not disclose numeric thresholds, annotator assignment, adjudication, agreement, or per-item decisions, so the predicate cannot be replayed exactly.

value_zh.html: 当专家评审将其保留——可能在人工修订之后——为足够复杂、清晰、正确且推理密集时，生成的问答对进入 top-100 集合。论文未披露数值阈值、标注者分配、裁决、一致性或逐条决定，因此该谓词无法精确重放。

value.html: Downstream full-fine-tuning experiments use TinyLLaMA-1.1B-Chat, LLaMA2-7B, LLaMA3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Qwen2.5-32B in different tables; a Qwen2.5-7B model is used for the separate formula-derivation evaluation.

value.html: Source-document derivations are the intended answer authority. GPT-o1-Pro drafts queries and retrieves source answers for difficult stages, simpler agents handle expression extraction and filtering, and human mathematicians provide final selection and revision feedback.

value_zh.html: 来源文档推导是预期的答案权威。GPT-o1-Pro 为困难阶段起草查询并检索来源答案，较简单智能体处理表达式提取与过滤，人类数学家提供最终选择与修订反馈。

value.html: STORM comprises Math Expression Extractor, Query Draft, Answer Retriever, Context Collector, Question Refiner, and Answer Filter agents. The paper reports GPT-o1-Pro for Query Draft and Answer Retriever; current scripts default mostly to gemini-2.0-flash-exp and use deepseek-chat for the derivation-versus-definition filter, so the public code is not an exact manifest of the reported run.

value.html: Paper-level filtering uses publication/review status, a May 2023–October 2024 window, and derivation keywords appearing more than five times. Answer retrieval skips questions without source support. A classifier keeps derivation/proof answers over definitions, and experts apply reasoning type, clarity, correctness, and density criteria to reduce 2,000 generated pairs to 100. Stage counts and decisions before 2,000 are unknown.

value_zh.html: 论文级过滤使用发表/评审状态、2023 年 5 月–2024 年 10 月窗口，以及出现超过五次的推导关键词。答案检索跳过无来源支撑的问题。分类器保留推导/证明答案而非定义，专家应用推理类型、清晰度、正确性与密度标准将 2,000 个生成对减至 100。2,000 之前的阶段计数与决定未知。

value.html: The authors report a one-month GPT-o1-Pro subscription costing about USD 200, roughly 20 minutes per paper for the multi-agent system, about 15 minutes of expert processing for roughly 30 question-answer samples per paper, occasional two- or three-attempt retries, and three weeks of prompt engineering. The number of candidate papers, total model calls/tokens, expert count/hours, and total end-to-end cost are unknown.

value_zh.html: 作者报告为期一个月、花费约 USD 200 的 GPT-o1-Pro 订阅，多智能体系统每篇论文约 20 分钟，每篇论文约 30 个问答样本约 15 分钟的专家处理，偶尔两或三次重试，以及三周提示工程。候选论文数量、总模型调用/tokens、专家人数/小时与端到端总成本未知。

value.html: The paper says models are fully fine-tuned on STORM-BORN but does not disclose optimizer, learning rate, batch size, epochs, scheduler, seeds, or compute. The repository contains no training implementation; its README shows an explicitly typical Axolotl command with an unrelated example model, so those illustrative values are not treated as paper-run hyperparameters.

value_zh.html: 论文称模型在 STORM-BORN 上全微调，但未披露优化器、学习率、batch size、epochs、调度器、种子或算力。仓库不含训练实现；其 README 展示一条带无关示例模型的明确典型 Axolotl 命令，因此那些示例值不被视为论文运行超参数。

value.html: The live final file contains 100 unique questions from 28 distinct paper values. Most are arXiv identifiers, but the list also contains Convex Optimization, Numerical Optimization, Real Analysis: Modern Techniques and Their Applications, and A Connection Between Score Matching and Denoising Autoencoders, plus arxiv:2501.18922 and arxiv:2502.16894. This does not match a literal recent-arXiv-only May 2023–October 2024 source rule.

value_zh.html: 当前最终文件包含来自 28 个不同 paper 值的 100 个唯一问题。多数是 arXiv 标识符，但列表还包含 Convex Optimization、Numerical Optimization、Real Analysis: Modern Techniques and Their Applications 与 A Connection Between Score Matching and Denoising Autoencoders，外加 arxiv:2501.18922 与 arxiv:2502.16894。这与字面的仅限近期 arXiv、2023 年 5 月–2024 年 10 月来源规则不匹配。

value.html: storm_born_train.jsonl has 73 rows and storm_born_test.jsonl 27; together they exactly partition the 100 unique questions with no question overlap. The data README calls it a random split but gives no seed. Seventeen of the test set's 18 source identifiers also occur in train, so the split is not source-document-disjoint.

value_zh.html: storm_born_train.jsonl 有 73 行，storm_born_test.jsonl 有 27 行；二者恰好划分 100 个唯一问题且无问题重叠。数据 README 称之为随机划分但未给出 seed。测试集 18 个来源标识符中的 17 个也出现在 train 中，因此该划分并非来源文档不相交。

value.html: The paper argues that recent sources reduce contamination, but no exact, near-duplicate, memorization, or benchmark-overlap audit is reported. The live release includes sources outside the stated date range and source type, and the source-overlapping train/test split further prevents treating freshness as decontamination evidence.

value_zh.html: 论文主张近期来源减少污染，但未报告精确、近重复、记忆或基准重叠审计。当前发布包含所述日期范围与来源类型之外的来源，而来源重叠的 train/test 划分进一步阻止将新鲜度视为去污染证据。

items: A source-grounded answer can inherit an error, unstated assumption, notation dependency, or later correction from the source document.
Extracted derivations may lose page-local definitions, citation dependencies, diagrams, or equation context when converted to a self-contained question.
Expert review is necessary but not independently reproducible without annotator count, qualifications per topic, assignments, agreement, adjudication, thresholds, and revision logs.
The paper says selection follows five principles but enumerates only four, leaving the rubric specification internally inconsistent.
The current source list contradicts the described arXiv/date filter and lacks review-score evidence, so source-selection claims cannot be reconstructed from the artifact.
Random item splitting leaves 17 source documents shared across train and test, allowing document-specific concepts, notation, or phrasing to leak across the evaluation boundary.
Multiple-choice distractor-generation provenance and validation are not published; a model can exploit option artifacts rather than derive the answer.
The 2,000 generated pool, top-500 subset, unfiltered full set, rejected items, and expert revisions used in the quality ablation are not released.

The repository exposes a hard-coded Google API-key-like credential in a generation script; it is not reproduced in this Card, and users should treat it as compromised and use environment-based secrets.
The README's MIT statement is unsupported by a license file, while third-party derivation text creates separate copyright and attribution obligations.
来源有依据的答案可能从来源文档继承错误、未陈述假设、记号依赖或随后的更正。
提取的推导在转换为自包含问题时可能丢失页局部定义、引用依赖、图表或方程上下文。
专家评审是必要的，但在无标注者人数、按主题的资质、分配、一致性、裁决、阈值与修订日志时不可独立复现。
论文称选择遵循五条原则但只枚举四条，使评分标准规格内部不一致。
当前来源列表与所述 arXiv/日期过滤矛盾，且缺少评审分数证据，因此来源选择主张无法从产物重构。
随机条目划分使 17 个来源文档在 train 与 test 间共享，允许文档特定概念、记号或措辞跨评测边界泄漏。
多项选择题干扰项生成出处与验证未发布；模型可利用选项伪迹而非推导答案。
质量消融中使用的 2,000 生成池、top-500 子集、未过滤全集、被拒绝条目与专家修订未发布。
仓库在生成脚本中暴露硬编码的类 Google API 密钥凭据；本卡片中不复现，用户应将其视为已泄露并使用基于环境的密钥。
README 的 MIT 声明无许可文件支撑，而第三方推导文本产生单独的版权与归属义务。

value.html: The repository README claims MIT, but the checked Git tree contains no LICENSE file and the GitHub API reports no detected license. The released rows reproduce or lightly edit derivation text from third-party papers/books without per-source license or attribution fields. Repository code license, dataset license, and compatibility with every source therefore remain unknown.

value_zh.html: 仓库 README 声称 MIT，但所检查的 Git 树不含 LICENSE 文件，且 GitHub API 报告未检测到许可。已发布行复现或轻度编辑第三方论文/书籍的推导文本，而无逐来源许可或归属字段。因此仓库代码许可、数据集许可以及与每一来源的兼容性仍未知。

value.html: Intended lineage is candidate document to formula/expression to draft query to source-retrieved answer to collected context to self-contained question to derivation/definition filter to expert retain/reject/revise decision to top-100 row and derived splits/options. The public row retains only a coarse paper identifier, final question, and final answer; intermediate expressions, evidence spans, prompts/models, revision history, reviewer decision, and parent option-generation records are absent.

value_zh.html: 预期谱系是候选文档到公式/表达式到草稿查询到来源检索答案到收集的上下文到自包含问题到推导/定义过滤到专家保留/拒绝/修订决定到 top-100 行及派生划分/选项。公开行仅保留粗粒度 paper 标识符、最终问题与最终答案；中间表达式、证据跨度、提示/模型、修订历史、评审决定与父选项生成记录缺失。
